text:
Ben K.: @channel seeing spike in 5xx + streaming disconnects starting ~12:07 PDT in us-west-2. Multiple customers reporting aborted streams and partial responses. Error rate on /v1/stream jumped from 0.3% -> 6.8% in last 3m. Gateway errors + timeouts in the API gateway logs.
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging on-call: @Alice M. (primary oncall) — incident created 1763002001 — severity: P1 — summary: streaming disconnects + 5xx spike (us-west-2). Runbook: https://go/redwood/runbooks/streaming-disconnects
Alice M.: on it. joining console now. any customer-impacting orders? Ben, list most-impacted customers and the routes they hit.
Ben K.: A: AcmeChat (enterprise), uses streaming heavily on /v1/stream; B: BetaInc test cluster hitting /v1/generate with stream=true; also seeing a lot of 502/504 at the gateway. sample logs (from gateway):
```
[2026-02-18T19:07:14Z] upstream error: read tcp 10.0.1.4:443->10.0.2.10:43210: connection reset by peer
[2026-02-18T19:07:15Z] 502 error from upstream: grpc: received unexpected EOF
[2026-02-18T19:07:20Z] proxy timeout: client canceled
```
Maya S.: opening metrics dash — looks like model-worker memory (Rss) for the streaming pool increased prior to spike, then retries increased. Could be KV cache thrash causing OOMs and worker restarts. Pods showing restarts ~ 19:06:50Z.
Raj P.: throwing in some context: we recently rolled out change to continuous-batching and a kernel path optimized for long seqs last week. Possible regression under certain seq-length distributions. Also saw a small increase in request size in the last hour from AcmeChat (long prefixes).
Charlie L.: network side: no infra wide network events. NLB healthy, but envoy upstream clusters show 5xx from model-backend cluster.
Alice M.: immediate mitigations to reduce customer impact: 1) switch affected routes to non-streaming fallback (buffered responses) 2) increase proxy timeouts to avoid premature gateway 504s 3) reduce batch size / disable the new continuous-batching on streaming pool 4) scale up streaming worker replicas by +2. Which is least risky to try now?
Raj P.: ordering mitigations by risk: (low) increase proxy timeouts; (low) enable non-streaming fallback for AcmeChat via routing rule; (medium) scale replicas; (medium) rollback continuous-batch flag for streaming pool; (high) full rollback of kernel change.
Maya S.: I'll apply proxy timeout change now on the gateway (staging -> prod via canary). Patch snippet:
```
# nginx conf (canary)
proxy_connect_timeout 60s;
proxy_send_timeout 120s;
proxy_read_timeout 120s;
send_timeout 120s;
```
I'll monitor for 10m.
Ben K.: support note drafted to AcmeChat: "We're investigating streaming disconnects and may enable a buffered (non-streaming) fallback. We'll update in 15m." -- ready to send once we decide.
incident-bot: Action logged: gateway timeouts updated (canary) by Maya S. — 1763002105
Maya S.: canary looks okay. applying to 50% traffic. monitoring shows downstream 502s reduced slightly but not resolved.
Alice M.: next step: toggle non-streaming fallback for AcmeChat to preserve full responses. Raj, can you add route rule now to send streaming requests for that customer to /v1/generate?
Raj P.: done. Routing rule created and applied (route-id r-az2f). Quick config: send stream requests -> buffered backend, max_latency_hint=5000ms.
Charlie L.: scaling streaming worker replicas +2 in us-west-2 now (k8s deployment model-streaming-pool). Starting new pods: model-streaming-1/2/3 -> 5 replicas.
Ben K.: notify sent to AcmeChat: "We enabled a buffered fallback so you should see full responses rather than interrupted streams. Expect a small latency increase. We're continuing to investigate root cause."
Maya S.: after scaling + timeout tweak + fallback routing, 5xx rate dropped to 1.1% and streaming disconnect reports decreased. But still seeing intermittent 502s when sequences are >8k tokens.
Raj P.: that suggests KV cache pressure at longer sequences. temporary workaround: cap max_prefix_length for streaming pool to 8k for now and route >8k to dedicated large-seq variant (less optimized but more stable). I'll push config patch:
```
# model runtime config
streaming_pool:
  max_prefix_tokens: 8192
  continuous_batching: false
```
Pushing now.
Alice M.: we need to coordinate rollback window if this makes perf worse. How long until patch reconciled?
Raj P.: 90s for config push, 5min for rolling restart of runtime workers. Doing restart with controlled rolling update to avoid full capacity loss.
Charlie L.: watch for CPU spike during restart. I've pre-warmed one standby instance.
incident-bot: Action logged: runtime config updated (max_prefix_tokens=8192, continuous_batching disabled) by Raj P. — 1763002348
Maya S.: rolling restarts finished. Observability: 502/504s down to 0.4%. streaming error reports near-zero. Pod restart counts stabilized.
Diane R.: product note — any customer-visible degraded features? We rolled to buffered fallback, and some latency bump. Should we proactively open a support ticket with SLO compensation?
Ben K.: creating a PSR for AcmeChat and BetaInc + CS outreach. Will include description of mitigation and ETA for postmortem.
Alice M.: handoff: I'm going offline in 30m. Raj, can you take follow-up and lead postmortem? Please keep monitoring for 1h and open a redirect incident if metrics increase.
Raj P.: taking over. Setting follow-up runbook tasks: collect heap profiles from workers, dump KV cache metrics, correlate sequence length distribution from request logs, and check kernel path regression test.
Maya S.: I'll keep the alert suppression window 60m and watch dashboards.
Charlie L.: leaving infra watch on standby for any scaling required.
incident-bot: Severity: P1 -> mitigation achieved. Monitoring window started 1763002450 for 60m.
Ben K.: posted customer-facing status update to AcmeChat and internal CS thread.
Alice M.: thanks all. we'll convert to postmortem once root cause confirmed. handing to Raj for next steps. :thumbsup:
Raj P.: collecting artifacts now. I'll file the incident postmortem doc and assign owners for kernel regression testing and long-seq perf improvements. Closing the urgent remediation loop.
incident-bot: Incident status changed: mitigated -> monitoring (1763002845).
